answer:
The Household expenses page now shows only Food and Housing. The total, the percentage bar, the category list and the "Latest" list all count just those two categories. The "Add an expense" form offers only Food and Housing as categories.

The Bills and Health entries (Electricity and Dentist) are still in the note's table. The page just hides them.

I also fixed a bug: the page wasn't recognising your "Amt" column as the amount, so it was probably showing "Add a table with an Amount column" instead of your data. It reads "Amt" correctly now.

The tool also warned that the form inputs have no labels, which affects screen readers. I didn't change that.
